name: First-line HFrEF treatments
description: Core GDMT for HFrEF: ARNi/ACEi/ARB + BB + MRA + SGLT2i (Class I)

name: Heart Failure general treatments
description: Broad HF treatments including diuretics, vaccines, lifestyle

name: HFpEF treatments
description: SGLT2i is Class IIa for HFpEF, diuretics for congestion

name: Cardiac amyloidosis treatment
description: Tafamidis for ATTR cardiac amyloidosis (Class I)

name: NSAIDs contraindicated in HF
description: NSAIDs and COX-2 inhibitors should not be used in HF

name: Thiazolidinediones contraindicated in HF
description: TZDs should not be used in HFrEF (Class III Harm)

name: Non-DHP CCBs contraindicated in HFrEF
description: Diltiazem/verapamil should not be used in HFrEF

name: Spironolactone monitoring
description: MRA requires potassium and renal function monitoring

name: Digoxin monitoring
description: Digoxin requires serum level monitoring (target 0.5-0.9 ng/mL)

name: SGLT2i renal monitoring
description: SGLT2 inhibitors require eGFR monitoring

name: Carvedilol dosing for HFrEF
description: Carvedilol has specific starting and target doses for HFrEF

name: Sacubitril/Valsartan dosing
description: ARNi has specific starting and target doses

name: ACEi NOT contraindicated in HF
description: ACE inhibitors are first-line for HF — must NOT appear as contraindicated in HF

name: Beta Blocker NOT contraindicated in HFrEF
description: Beta blockers are first-line for HFrEF — must NOT be contraindicated

name: ICD device therapy for HFrEF
description: ICD is recommended for primary prevention in HFrEF with LVEF ≤35%

name: CRT device therapy
description: CRT recommended for HFrEF with LBBB and QRS ≥150ms

name: Advanced HF treatments
description: Cardiac transplantation and MCS for advanced HF

name: Dobutamine contraindicated in sulfite allergy
description: Dobutamine contains sodium bisulfite — contraindicated in sulfite allergy

name: Sotalol contraindicated in HFrEF
description: Sotalol increases mortality in HFrEF patients

name: Vericiguat monitoring
description: Vericiguat requires NT-proBNP monitoring
